policy.question: Will we land on budget this month?
policy.why: It needs this month's actual spend and Google's 2× daily and 30.4× monthly limits; Google's simulators replay a past week and don't project calendar months.

policy.question: What will the next 30 days look like?
policy.why: Performance Planner isn't available in the Google Ads API, so there is no Google forecast to read.

policy.question: What if one campaign's daily budget changes?
policy.leadLabel: Google's budget simulator, when available, fresh and in range
policy.why: It replays the campaign's recent auctions at other budgets (Performance Max too, when Google returns a simulation); our model only sees the spend the campaign actually had.

policy.question: What if a target CPA or target ROAS changes?
How should budget move between campaigns?
policy.leadLabel: Our optimizer, fed with Google simulator curves where available
policy.why: Google's simulators work one campaign at a time; the optimizer compares marginal returns across campaigns.

policy.question: What if a shared budget changes?
policy.leadLabel: Our model, for the shared budget as a whole
policy.why: Google simulates each campaign on a shared budget as if the budget were its own; those campaigns compete for one budget, so their simulations don't add up to it.
